assertions.requirement: One ordered deterministic/LLM evaluator pipeline applies to task and workflow evidence.
Candidate and judge harness/model identities are independent and provider-agnostic.
Custom prompt/rubric, strict JSON, legacy verdict, blinding, and visible identity are hash-bound.
Rejudge appends a generation over retained evidence without candidate dispatch or mutation.
A required deterministic correctness/safety failure cannot be overridden by judge prose.
Malformed, timeout, missing-identity, privacy, and harness failures remain invalid with unknown quality.
